fields.statement: At 0e42aa383 ran go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run 'TestWatchdog(Budget|Holds)': both PASS. TestWatchdogHolds polls (watchdogPasses) four spent-budget failed runs with a hold saved before: one abandoned, one with change set withdrawn, one rejected, one plain failed; the poll's holds (written to state.WatchdogHolds by daemonWatchdog) and watchdogHoldItems keep only the plain failed run's one hold/item. Mutation check in a scratch worktree (watchdogLiveHolds removed) makes the test fail with all four holds kept. Diff read: watchdogLiveHolds drops holds whose run State().Abandoned() or whose change set is changeset.Dropped (withdrawn/rejected/superseded), with change state from the inbox fold; go vet and gofmt clean.
